integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically from the published permutation-cycle formula for Frobenius maps. The lower bound is witnessed on coordinate-idempotent tuples and the upper bound follows from the same exact formula; finite checks are regression tests only.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification is for additive maps from the split algebra \(\mathbb F_p^r\) to \(\mathbb F_p\) under the normalization-free 2026 definition.
No claim is made for determinant-law pseudocharacters, larger coefficient rings, or nonsplit and nonsemisimple source algebras.
An equivalent statement under older small-characteristic Taylor-pseudocharacter terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact Frobenius degree of every additive map on a split finite algebra
